description:
## Why This Exists

store/overview.rs::OverviewStore consistently casts u64 article_number to i64 for SQLite storage (as i64) and back (as u64). If article_number exceeds i64::MAX (9223372036854775807), the cast silently wraps, corrupting the stored number. The same pattern appears in ArticleNumberStore.

SQLite integers are signed 64-bit; sqlx requires i64 for binding. The cast is necessary but the overflow is unguarded.

## Acceptance Criteria

Add an overflow check: if article_number > i64::MAX as u64, return an error rather than silently wrapping. In practice article numbers this large are impossible, but the check documents the assumption.
title: Rust idiom: OverviewStore uses i64 cast for u64 article numbers without overflow check
